$comment: Terrain kinds. The order is the terrain index stored in a map (index = position in this object), so only ever append. frame = atlas frame (data/atlas.json); decor = how the view dresses the cell (trees on forest); seasonal = the season tint of seasons.json multiplies its colour; buildable = an ordinary building may stand here (a building's own `terrain` list overrides it); roadable = a road may be laid here.
